Contact support
I’ve found a project. What’s next?
Please contact the relevant supervisor to discuss your interest in the project. In your communication, you will need to provide copies of the following documents so they can determine if you’re a suitable match:
Academic transcripts
Curriculum Vitae (CV), using our structured CV template
English language test results (if applicable).
What if I can’t find a project that interests me?
You may already have a great idea for a research project, or may have looked through the available projects and can’t find one that matches your interests. As a starting point, we recommend browsing potential supervisors from your field and making a list of who you think may be a good match for your idea. We can then help you to find or confirm supervisors with whom to discuss your project idea.
Find a supervisor
Scholarship Disclaimer
The details contained in the research projects advertised on this webpage are indicative only and are subject to review and change without notice. Prior to the issue of any scholarship offer, the University will conduct a review of the relevant funding arrangements and determine the final scholarship terms, conditions and entitlements. Advertised details may differ from the terms ultimately offered.
The University reserves the right to vary or withdraw this scholarship opportunity prior to the issue of a formal offer letter, and nothing in this advertisement creates any binding obligation on the University or any entitlement on the part of any applicant.
The final terms and conditions applicable to any scholarship will be set out exclusively in the formal scholarship offer letter issued by the University, together with any relevant Conditions of Award provided at the time of offer, and no prior communication, whether written or oral, shall form part of or vary those terms.
Project updates
Eligible Adelaide University Supervisors, please complete the online Graduate Research Project Submission Form to propose a new project for promotion.
To edit or remove an existing project on the website, please email the request to augrs.experience@adelaide.edu.au.
